svg.title: Field Operations: 5 Industrial Internships
svg.desc: 5 industrial deployments — shipping production architectures from sleep-pod platforms to decentralized mobile systems.

g.text: “5 industrial deployments — shipping production architectures from
sleep-pod platforms to decentralized mobile systems.”
Full Stack Developer Intern — IIIT Dharwad Research Park

text.tspan: Developed complete frontend and backend for a production-ready sleep-pod

g.text: booking platform with responsive UI, user/booking modules, admin operations, and scalable RESTful APIs.

text.tspan: Integrated Razorpay for secure payments and AWS services for deployment and data

g.text: handling, ensuring high reliability and seamless integration.

text.tspan: Engineered core frontend features for an on-demand home services mobile

g.text: application connecting users with technicians and service providers.

text.tspan: Architected the service provider module interface, implementing real-time booking

g.text: requests, live job updates, and a smooth user experience.
AI-Driven Search Optimization & International Client Solutions

text.tspan: Implemented a mobile-first, debounced search feature with optimized query

g.text: caching, cutting navigation and search latency by 30%.

text.tspan: Shipped user-facing features end-to-end (frontend to API) into production for

g.text: international client projects, elevating session retention.
Scalable Full-Stack Web Applications & Role-Based Systems

text.tspan: Developed and maintained scalable full-stack web applications using the MERN stack

g.text: with optimized MongoDB schema architecture and indexing.

text.tspan: Implemented JWT authentication systems, role-based access control (RBAC), and

g.text: optimized backend query logic for low-latency operations.
Full Stack Web Developer Intern — QuantumHarbour Technologies
3D Interactive Web Platforms & Facility Booking Engines

text.tspan: Built immersive 3D interactive web experiences using Spline, Framer Motion, and

g.text: React.js with optimized sub-second load times.

text.tspan: Developed a Facility/Ground Booking Web Application with automated schedule

g.text: management, booking workflows, and code quality enhancements.
